title: Lab: solve 3 different real-world tasks using prompts alone
body:
🛠 Lab exercise

Pick three tasks below (or substitute your own real tasks) — one from each category — and write a full, well-formed prompt for each:

  1. Writing: Draft a short, polite message declining a meeting invite while proposing an alternative time.
  2. Coding or data: Convert a block of messy CSV-style text into clean JSON.
  3. Creative: Brainstorm 10 taglines for a fictional product of your choosing.

For each, include task, context, format, and constraints — then evaluate whether the output matched what you specified.
